m: Cook the brown rice (25 to 30 minutes).
Dressing: fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, finely chopped chilli and garlic. Taste: hot, sour, salty, a little sweet.
Season the steak and sear in a smoking hot pan 2 to 3 minutes a side for medium-rare. Rest 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.
Toss the sliced steak and its juices with half the dressing.
Salad: torn lettuce, cucumber, halved tomatoes, thin red onion and a big handful of herbs.
Pile the beef on the salad, pour over the rest of the dressing and finish with crushed peanuts. Rice on the side.
l: Pack the dressing separately and toss just before eating.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the fish sauce.
